phases.title: Product requirements, boundaries and design decisions
phases.gate: Written scope, architecture, threat model and review gates approved.

phases.title: Repository, tooling and developer workstation
phases.gate: Documented frontend, API and controlled fixture skeleton; shared contracts and CI available; data-service profiles are optional until integrated.

phases.title: Backend platform and persistence
phases.gate: Migrations, API scaffolding and database transactions run in tests and Compose.

phases.title: Platform authentication, authorization and tenant boundaries
phases.gate: Users can access only their own projects, runs and artifacts.

phases.title: Frontend design system and app shell
phases.gate: Accessible responsive app shell can load typed API data.

phases.title: Projects, settings and project ownership flows
phases.gate: Create, read, edit and delete a project from UI to database.

phases.title: Target authorization, URL policy and network defense
phases.gate: Unsafe destinations and out-of-scope navigation fail closed before browser access.

phases.title: Website discovery service and persisted page inventory
phases.gate: Authorized small site is crawled reproducibly with bounded page/element inventory.

phases.title: Website discovery user experience
phases.gate: Users can launch discovery and inspect evidence-backed page inventory.

phases.title: Gemini/OpenAI provider-independent AI integration
phases.gate: Both selected providers return normalized, validated typed responses or controlled errors.

phases.title: AI test generation and strict test specification schema
phases.gate: Generation produces useful test scenarios that pass semantic validation, never arbitrary scripts.

phases.title: Test case review, editing and explicit approval
phases.gate: Only validated, approved and correctly-versioned test specs are runnable.

phases.title: Celery/Redis queues and job lifecycle orchestration
phases.gate: Retries, cancellation and crashes converge on a consistent state machine.

phases.title: Controlled Playwright execution engine
phases.gate: Runner executes only the approved action DSL in isolated browser context.

phases.title: Evidence capture, artifact storage and execution results
phases.gate: Failures have durable, authorized evidence that can be inspected and downloaded.

phases.title: AI-assisted failure analysis and fix suggestions
phases.gate: Failure summaries are evidence-grounded hypotheses, not automatically confirmed defects.

phases.title: Bug report workflow and human verification
phases.gate: Suspected bugs are reviewable, reproducible and never silently auto-confirmed.

phases.title: Dashboard, history and downloadable reports
phases.gate: User can review run history and export accurate, safe evidence-backed reports.

phases.title: Integrated quality verification and benchmark expansion
phases.gate: All nine repository full-MVP success scenarios pass against controlled demo application.

phases.title: Security, privacy, reliability and cost hardening
phases.gate: Critical security cases and operational recovery tests pass before release.

phases.title: Release packaging, deployment documentation and handoff
phases.gate: Release candidate is reproducible, documented, and shows the complete MVP workflow.

phases.title: Post-MVP roadmap (explicitly deferred, not forgotten)
phases.gate: Each future capability has a scoped specification, security review and regression tests.

pilot.Acceptance criterion: API probes, frontend build, fixture browser check, CI and backlog check pass from locked dependencies.

pilot.Task: Freeze requirements, schemas, limits and network boundaries
pilot.Acceptance criterion: Shared contracts reject unknown actions; fixture expected behavior and benchmark release thresholds are recorded.

pilot.Task: Persist one local project and requirement revisions
pilot.Acceptance criterion: A local owner can create one project; migrations and immutable requirement revision references are verified.

pilot.Task: Discover the single controlled fixture page
pilot.Acceptance criterion: Persist the expected forms and controls in one bounded, versioned snapshot; no public or arbitrary target URL is accepted.

pilot.Task: Generate a validated test through one provider adapter
pilot.Acceptance criterion: Gemini or a local test double produces a semantically valid test linked to approved requirement and snapshot revisions within budgets.

pilot.Task: Review and approve an exact test revision
pilot.Acceptance criterion: The UI shows the candidate and expected behavior; approval binds exact spec, requirement and scope digests; edits invalidate approval.

pilot.Task: Execute the approved fixture case in an isolated job
pilot.Acceptance criterion: The restricted runner revalidates the envelope, executes only fixture actions, enforces limits and cancellation, and returns typed results without infrastructure credentials.

pilot.Task: Persist results and screenshot; display them locally
pilot.Acceptance criterion: The orchestrator stores results and checksum-verified evidence; the UI shows the correct outcome and screenshot for the immutable run.

pilot.Task: Pass repeatability, safety and benchmark gates
pilot.Acceptance criterion: The expanded benchmark meets docs/QUALITY_GATES.md thresholds; rejected specs and revoked approvals never execute; interruption cleanup is tested.

pilot.Task: Reproduce the pilot from a clean checkout
pilot.Acceptance criterion: Another maintainer follows documented setup and demonstrates the complete fixture workflow; remaining limitations and measured throughput are recorded.
